name: Zap! The Magic
source:
Hero moves to locations on the map and experiences random encounters with the monsters on the way. Through winning a battle consisting of Magic: The Gathering card game match player gets money that he can spend on new cards in city shop and on winning event battles with bosses he also advances his HP and SC pools.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/08/vn-of-month-september-1996.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
英雄移动到地图上的位置，并在途中随机遇到怪物。通过赢得一场由《万智牌》卡牌游戏组成的战斗，玩家可以获得金钱，他可以在城市商店中购买新卡牌，并且在赢得与老板的活动战斗时，他还可以提高他的HP和SC池。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/08/vn-of-month-september-1996.html]vndbreview[/url]]
